description: This file defines a helper class for logging, providing static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It manages a chain of LogNode objects to which log data is sent. The class essentially acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, allowing custom log handling while maintaining familiar logging methods.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels and managing a chain of LogNode objects.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which logs are sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Forwards a log message with given priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a VERBOSE message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a DEBUG message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an INFO message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a WARN message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an ERROR message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an ASSERT level message with optional Throwable.
